_comment: Source URLs for this skill's reference files. Run scripts/update-references.py to refresh. docs.github.com URLs are fetched as Markdown via the docs article API.

references/config-schema.md.covers: ~/.copilot directory layout, settings.json (user/repo/local keys and precedence), config.json (trustedFolders), allowed_models.txt, MDM managed settings, environment variables, authentication, BYOK providers and providers.json, model usage

references/permissions.md.covers: Trusted directories, tool/path/URL permission flags, permission patterns, tool names, approval prompts and modes, permissions-config.json schema, sandbox settings, allow-all restriction, managed permission rules

references/cli-commands.md.covers: Terminal subcommands, command-line options, session management, slash commands

references/mcp.md.covers: mcp-config.json and project .mcp.json/.github/mcp.json, loading priority, transport types and fields, OAuth, /mcp and copilot mcp commands, governance, LSP servers (lsp-config.json, .github/lsp.json, /lsp)

references/hooks.md.covers: Hook sources and load order, file format, command/http/prompt entries, all hook events, input payloads, decision output, matchers, exit codes, disableAllHooks, debugging

references/skills.md.covers: SKILL.md frontmatter fields, skill locations and priority, commands format, /skills and copilot skill commands, allowed-tools

references/agents-plugins.md.covers: Custom agent locations and frontmatter, subagent settings, built-in and sidekick agents, plugin commands, enabledPlugins/extraKnownMarketplaces, plugin.json and marketplace.json, precedence

references/instructions.md.covers: Instruction file locations, applyTo/excludeAgent frontmatter, how files combine, @ imports, subagent instructions, /instructions and copilot instruction
